title: Suggest five project-based assessment ideas for [topic] suitable for [grade level] students
text: Suggest five project-based assessment ideas for [topic] suitable for [grade level] students. Include a brief description and what skills each project assesses.
problem: Bahan pengajaran atau sokongan pembelajaran untuk “Suggest five project-based assessment ideas for [topic] suitable for [grade level] students” belum disediakan.
output: Jadual berstruktur; ketepatan angka dan sumber mesti diperiksa.
hook: Topik sudah dipilih, tetapi cara menerangkannya masih sukar difahami?
solution: Tugasan: Prompt 73. Tetapkan tahap pelajar, objektif, contoh dan kaedah pentaksiran; semak fakta serta kesesuaian hasil untuk pembelajaran.
cta: Cuba pada satu topik; semak fakta dan sesuaikan kepada tahap pelajar.
